## What's new in 1.0.0

First release.

- Turns on the game mode (low-latency mode) of Bluetooth headphones every time they connect
  to the PC, over RFCOMM, and checks that it is really on when the profile can read the state.
- Built-in profiles for the Edifier X2s and the Realme Buds T200 Lite, picked automatically
  on the first run when the headphones are already paired.
- Other headphones can be added from the advanced device settings, with Test ON / Test OFF /
  Read state and JSON import and export of the profile.
